text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
The Yasuda Kinen—the moment to showcase my 
"speed"! The speed of one who aspires to 
destroy destiny itself!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Gathered here are legendary wind 
goddesses. Yet, among them stands one who 
fears not the fiercest gale.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
My eyes cannot be deceived, O admirer of 
flowers amidst the storm! Are you, too, 
one who bears the mantle of destiny?!
